title: American Gooey Meat Casserole
description: A floral, gooey, and quick-fix American dish featuring ground cumin, perfect for busy weeknights. This egg-free-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional comfort food.
instructions: Cook the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle the flour over the beef mixture and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the chicken broth, cumin, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the cheddar cheese.
Drizzle the infuse-oil over the cheese and sprinkle with cilantro.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
